definitions.explanation: Shoulders that are broad and sit high and level rather than sloping, as if raised in anger. Used to describe a person's build or posture; the opposite of sloping shoulders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いかり{肩|がた}だ。
いかり{肩|がた}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{似合|にあ}わない→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: My shoulders are too square for this kind of top.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧、いかり{肩|がた}になってしまう。
examples.english: When I get nervous, I tense up and my shoulders hunch up high.

notes:
Also written {怒|いか}り{肩|がた}: the shoulders look raised as in anger. The ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ is voiced to がた in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- いかり{肩|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: a man with square shoulders
- いかり{肩|がた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes that soften square shoulders

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なで{肩|がた}: sloping shoulders (the opposite)
- ⟦{肩幅|かたはば}→肩幅：27827_katahaba⟧: shoulder width
